title: DEPS — Your Organization Product Communication Adapter

sprint.name: Your Organization Product Communication Adapter

evidence.claimBoundary: Sixty-nine deterministic mapping, source-fidelity, provenance, availability, alternatives, Evidence-role, replay, non-mutation, active-equivalence, and rollback checks.
Field inventory, ownership, hidden-priority audit, semantic parity, Local Understanding Utility, activation readiness, and rollback.

scorecard.rationale: The adapter maps a completed plan without creating, selecting, ranking, or revising cognition.
The candidate remains inactive and no real-user outcome was measured.
No participation, contribution, shared learning, or cross-scope behavior changed.
The product boundary now preserves plan provenance, protected availability, uncertainty, alternatives, and Evidence roles without Runtime fallback.
A pure local adapter isolates product shaping from communication policy and retains an exact rollback boundary.

architecture.observation: Plan semantics remain upstream while the adapter owns shape-only compatibility.
Policy, priority, projection, disclosure, revision, canonical references, uncertainty, alternatives, and Evidence roles survive mapping.
The active Phase 8A route remains byte-identical and does not import the candidate.

benchmarks.summary: The inactive adapter is deterministic, source-faithful, provenance-complete, availability-preserving, Runtime-independent, and locally reversible.
The structured communication contract remains passing with additive Evidence-role pass-through.
The disclosed projection boundary remains passing.
The prior compatibility candidate remains passing and inactive.
The active Runtime-backed experience remains unchanged.

researchObservations.observation: Action Utility, Continuity reference preservation, and Trust Calibration have benchmark support; user Understanding Gain and Cognitive Load Reduction remain hypotheses.

introduced: Additive comparative Evidence-role pass-through in the communication plan.
One measurement source and versioned DEPS report.
complexity.justification: The bounded additions demonstrate a source-preserving product boundary without changing Runtime, routes, UI, cognition, or disclosure.

governanceObservations.observation: Protected states and semantic provenance reach the product boundary without fallback or narrative invention.

sustainabilityObservations.observation: The adapter is versioned, pure, normalized, non-persistent, inactive, and removable independently.

regressions.observation: Active route output is byte-identical and the new adapter is not imported.

unknownsAndUnmeasured.reason: No user-visible treatment, comprehension study, or decision outcome changed.
No production resolved-decision producer or durable revocation owner exists.
Generated explanation, why-it-matters, and change narrative remain unavailable by design.

remainingRisks.nextBlockingDependency: A real disclosure-decision producer is required before any candidate activation.
remainingRisks.remainingDiscoveryPhase: Phase 8 shadows remain inactive; broader Phase 5 Governance and Phase 6 remain paused.
remainingRisks.remainingBenchmarkGap: Real-user comprehension, browser behavior, active revocation, and narrative usefulness remain unmeasured.

rollback.description: Remove the adapter, validator, command, DEPS source/report, and documentation synchronization; active Phase 8A behavior remains unchanged.

engineeringDecision.rationale: Accept the inactive adapter and make disclosure-decision production the next separately authorized boundary.
